exposure: steroid dose and timing of administration
cohort: The study cohort comprised early preterm infants born to pregnant mothers who delivered between 28 0/7 and 33 6/7 weeks of gestation and had received antenatal corticosteroids (ACS).
finding: Early preterm neonates born to mothers with diabetes who received antenatal corticosteroids (ACS) demonstrated a significantly higher rate of neonatal hypoglycaemia compared to neonates born to mothers without diabetes who also received ACS.
